evidence_and_acceptance: Complete analytical proof, exact admissible counterexample, or honest remaining obligations with precise counterexample tests. Every carrier, law, normalization, limit, sign and dependency must be explicit. A restricted subcase remains partial. A diagnostic is not a universal proof. Supplied Pro advice and actual helper checks are not kernel acceptance or a full external audit.

Assuming local triple laws glue consistently around cycles
Assuming binary attraction/saturation holds for general alphabets
Averaging edge marginals instead of exact individual laws
Replacing actual common powers by independent PSD kernels
Counterexample A lacking an actual nonnegative Markov square root
Dropping constant/proper-term surplus or assuming refuted per-mode positivity
Presenting an equivalent missing inequality as an easier solved lemma
